reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Matched wild-type versus kinase-dead K rescue in K-loss cells; proposed orthogonal confirmation assessed where used.

checks.reason: No explicit prior Methods/supplement/validated-protocol consultation and detailed condition-transfer verification before execution.
K-locus and rescue identity are qualified, but no cancer-line authentication, contamination or passage-integrity gate is specified for the cell preparation.
No quantitative delivery/preparation/medium/recovery conditions or concrete calibration procedure choosing those settings before confirmation.
Direct kinase activity sensitivity is calibrated well, but the primary phospho-S measurement lacks a specific antibody/orthogonal specificity and quantitative accuracy acceptance gate.
The optional rescue index correctly excludes a near-zero WT denominator, but the underlying phospho/total-S endpoint lacks background, below-limit/missing and saturation handling rules.
A mixed model, confidence intervals and equivalence logic are explicit, but the family correction/gatekeeping procedure is only named as a requirement rather than specified.
No bounded ligand/time exploration or procedure deriving its range/stopping point. Expression titration has a strong functional criterion but does not supply the missing ligand parameter design.
Construct replacement and assay repairs lack an explicit refrozen protocol and fresh independent confirmatory cohort.

The conditional orthogonal inhibitor and second-allele suggestions have no operational engagement/selectivity/scaffold validation procedure. Independent null backgrounds alone replicate protein loss, not catalytic isolation.
Coded measurements and locked analysis do not supply raw-file/sample identifiers and exact model/code/environment/settings provenance.

Careful packet attribution, process-matched controls, independently derived rescue populations and pilot power, randomized blinded balanced measurement and technical stopping. WT titration ties residual activity detection and expression matching to biological rescue, an important strength. Main causal decision respects noncatalytic versus scaffold-specific claims, uses equivalence and separates growth from signaling. Concrete diagnostics address associated kinases and failed constructs. Execution calibration and independent catalytic confirmation remain incomplete.
